content.title: Braves, Comcast reach agreement to televise BravesVision on Xfinity
content.text: By Chad BishopMarch 26, 2026ShareThe Braves and Comcast announced Thursday a distribution agreement to provide the BravesVision network to its Xfinity customers.BravesVision, which will air pregame, postgame and live-game telecasts, will be available on Xfinity beginning Friday.
